image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a black hockey puck resting on a neutral gray surface. The puck features a prominent white circular label on its top face with a stylized mountain logo and text that appears to be gibberish or AI-hallucinated characters. The side edge of the puck shows vertical ridges typical of hockey pucks.

The geometry is consistent with a solid disk; no internal structures or transparency issues are visible.
The rubber body of the puck is matte black, contrasting with the white label.

The boundary between the white label and the black rubber shows slight softness and bleeding, lacking the crisp edge of a real printed sticker or heat-transfer logo.
